name: Anthothijah
overview: Anthothijah was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Shashak. The biblical record concerning him is concise, with no additional notes or details beyond his lineage. His mention is limited to genealogical context within the tribe of Benjamin.
namesAndTitles: The name Anthothijah is presented as a proper name in Scripture without any provided meaning or divine origin. Therefore, it is recognized simply as a personal name recorded in the biblical genealogies.
familyAndRelationships: Anthothijah is explicitly recorded as the son of Shashak. Beyond this paternal relationship, Scripture does not provide further family details or additional relational context for him.
scriptureSignificance: Anthothijah's significance lies in his inclusion in the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin, underscoring the biblical emphasis on lineage and tribal identity. His mention helps preserve the historical and familial continuity important to God's covenant people. Though not prominent in narrative events, his presence affirms the faithfulness of God in maintaining His chosen families as recorded in Scripture.
